0022600131.text: The Lakers (3-0, 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (2-0, 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West) in the fourth game of the season for Los Angeles, with a three-game winning streak and a 2-0 home record. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique, strain), while Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (ankle, soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Scoot Henderson is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Lakers lost 1-2, including a 132-116 defeat in Portland on January 17, 2026.
